-116.54600,33.83920.name: American Reproductive Centers
-116.54600,33.83920.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Maher A. Abdallah, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-0.13540,51.53079.name: Avenues
-0.13540,51.53079.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

CCAC certification is a condition of federal research funding rather than a licence, so an institution outside it is not necessarily outside the work — it may simply not take federal money. The CCAC publishes names and certificate status and no addresses, so this point marks the institution rather than the building where animals are held.

18.20361,46.07574.desc: A BSL4 laboratory, operational. Run by Institute of Biology, Faculty of Sciences, University of Pécs, Pécs. It is categorised as a university laboratory, working on animal health. Personnel work in full-body positive-pressure suits with their own air supply. Containment space: 55 SqM. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

127.10300,37.40200.name: Toolgen
127.10300,37.40200.desc: A South Korean gene-editing company holding CRISPR patents that were contested in the same interference proceedings as Broad and Berkeley. Its presence is a reminder that the patent estate everyone else licenses from is not purely American, and that a technique now central to world agriculture and medicine is owned in pieces by a handful of institutions across three continents.

-87.48900,36.86200.name: British American Tobacco — Kentucky BioProcessing
-87.48900,36.86200.desc: Owns a plant-made pharmaceutical business that grows proteins and vaccine candidates in engineered tobacco, including a COVID-19 candidate. Tobacco is the most studied plant in molecular biology and the easiest to engineer, so the industry with the most to lose from smoking decline holds one of the most capable plant-manufacturing platforms.
